WoW Forever · addon comparison

WoW Forever addon comparison: Waypoint Tracker vs TomTom, Questie, pfQuest and more

Choose Waypoint Tracker for a 3D waypoint arrow, Find by name and a complete trainer database on WoW Forever. Choose Questie for a quest-map overview, a leveling guide for a suggested quest sequence, or TomTom for its coordinate-waypoint workflow and arrow themes. TomTom-compatible addons can send supported waypoints to Waypoint Tracker when TomTom is absent.

Install Waypoint Tracker

Which should I use?

A 3D arrow, NPC/item/quest lookup and nearest trainers
Use Waypoint Tracker for Find, Nearest and Real routes to a destination you choose.
Coordinate waypoints and arrow themes
TomTom provides that workflow and lists Forever support; compare its arrow controls with Waypoint Tracker’s Find and travel tools.
A map overview of quests
Questie documents quest starts, objectives, turn-ins and journey history. Waypoint Tracker adds selected-destination navigation.
A suggested leveling sequence
Use a guide such as Zygor, RestedXP, Guidelime, WoW-Pro, Polestar or Wayfinder Forever. Check Forever coverage and guide maturity; a travel planner is a different task from choosing quests.
Browsable location pins
Use HandyNotes with the relevant Forever plugin. Rare, treasure, service, transport and book plugins have different datasets.
A replacement map workspace
Consider Carbonite All in One, OpenMap or Endless Map; Mapster and Leatrix Maps offer map adjustments.
Gathering, collections or dedicated alerts
Choose the specialist workflow: GatherMate2 or a Forever gathering tool, or RareScanner/SilverDragon for rare detection. These roles can complement destination navigation.

Waypoint Tracker: 3D arrow + Find

Waypoint Tracker combines a 3D waypoint arrow with Find for quests, NPCs, enemies, objects and items on WoW Forever. Real routes is a standard feature, on by default: it plans the fastest known usable journey, including flight paths, boats, zeppelins, the tram, hearthstone and usable teleports. The default Safe route preference asks before a quicker route crosses dangerous ground; Always fastest is optional.

Nearest ships a complete trainer database: over 500 trainers across capitals, starting areas and towns of both factions. It covers all nine classes, all 12 professions (including Cooking, First Aid and Fishing), weapon masters and riding trainers, including Alliance shaman and Horde paladin trainers. Positions favour observations from WoW Forever. Your discoveries add to the shipped database, so you can find trainers before visiting them. Nearest chooses the closest location for your faction; the 3D arrow takes you there by the fastest route. Use /wp, open Find and choose Nearest, or use the minimap button’s right-click Nearest menu.

Waypoint Tracker accepts supported TomTom waypoint calls when TomTom is absent. When TomTom is installed, Waypoint Tracker leaves /way and the waypoint API to it; /wp remains available.

Treasure hunt (beta) and Route sharing & votes (beta) are opt-in and off by default. Known spots are places to check for rares and chests.

TomTom vs Waypoint Tracker

TomTom supplies coordinate waypoints, map clicks, a floating arrow and corpse guidance. Choose TomTom for its waypoint workflow and arrow themes; choose Waypoint Tracker for a 3D arrow with built-in Find, Nearest and Real routes.

Can I use both?

Yes. When TomTom is installed, Waypoint Tracker leaves /way and the waypoint API to TomTom. Use /wp for Waypoint Tracker; third-party TomTom waypoints then belong to TomTom.

Full TomTom comparison

Questie vs Waypoint Tracker

Questie shows quest starts, objectives and turn-ins on the map, with a quest tracker and searchable database. Choose Questie for a quest-map overview and journey history; choose Waypoint Tracker for named destinations and a 3D arrow with travel planning.

Can I use both?

Questie documents TomTom objective arrows. Supported TomTom waypoint calls can target Waypoint Tracker when TomTom is absent; with TomTom installed, they target TomTom.

Full Questie comparison

pfQuest vs Waypoint Tracker

pfQuest combines a quest arrow, objective map nodes and a database browser for NPCs, items, objects and quests on its documented Vanilla/TBC clients. For a documented Forever 1.60.1 build, choose Waypoint Tracker; pfQuest is a relevant database and quest-helper comparison for its own supported clients.

Can I use both?

The checked pfQuest sources document Vanilla/TBC rather than a Forever build. Check for a compatible Forever release before pairing it with Waypoint Tracker.

Full pfQuest comparison

HandyNotes vs Waypoint Tracker

HandyNotes is a map-note framework with personal notes and separate plugins for location data. Choose HandyNotes and a suitable plugin for browsable map markers; choose Waypoint Tracker for Find and arrow guidance to a selected destination.

Can I use both?

Use a Forever-compatible HandyNotes build and plugin for map markers alongside Waypoint Tracker. Plugins with supported TomTom waypoint calls can target its arrow when TomTom is absent.

Corrections and updates

Report a changed feature or Forever release with its official URL

Questions and answers

Which WoW Forever addon combines a waypoint arrow with NPC and item search?

Waypoint Tracker combines a 3D arrow with Find for quests, NPCs, enemies, objects and items. It is free under the MIT licence and targets Forever 1.60.1, interface 16001.

Does Classic Era support establish WoW Forever compatibility?

No. Check for an explicit Forever release or official Forever documentation. Upstream pfQuest documents Vanilla/TBC clients; a Forever build was not verified in the checked sources.

Can TomTom-compatible addons send waypoints to Waypoint Tracker?

Waypoint Tracker accepts supported TomTom waypoint calls when TomTom is absent. When TomTom is installed, Waypoint Tracker leaves /way and the waypoint API to it; /wp remains available.

How do I find the nearest class or profession trainer in WoW Forever?

Nearest ships a complete trainer database: over 500 trainers across capitals, starting areas and towns of both factions. It covers all nine classes, all 12 professions (including Cooking, First Aid and Fishing), weapon masters and riding trainers, including Alliance shaman and Horde paladin trainers. Positions favour observations from WoW Forever. Your discoveries add to the shipped database, so you can find trainers before visiting them. Nearest chooses the closest location for your faction; the 3D arrow takes you there by the fastest route. Use /wp, open Find and choose Nearest, or use the minimap button’s right-click Nearest menu.

Should I use a leveling guide or Waypoint Tracker?

Use a leveling guide when you want instructions about which quests to accept, complete and turn in. Use Waypoint Tracker for Find, the shipped Nearest database and travel to your chosen destination.
